fonttweaks.blacklist: Characters to keep in the original font
fonttweaks.ui.title: FontTweaks - Text readability
fonttweaks.profile.replace_english: Use the bundled font for English too
fonttweaks.ui.profile.4: At GUI size 4 and above (large UI)
fonttweaks.preset.pixel_and_fonts: 2: Choose fonts for each GUI size
fonttweaks.ui.desc.global: Base multiplier for text size. 1.0 is normal, 1.2 is 20% larger and 0.8 is 20% smaller. This does not change font choice or dot coarseness.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.screen: Scales text while a menu, inventory or other screen is open. Multiplies the overall text size. FontTweaks configuration controls keep their normal size.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.hud: Scales in-game information text while no screen is open. HUD means information overlaid on the game view. Multiplies the overall size. Chat has its own setting.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.button: Scales only button labels. Button backgrounds and clickable areas stay the same size. Multiplies the overall and menu text sizes.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.chat: Scales chat text, backgrounds and click targets together. Also multiplies the overall size and Minecraft chat scale.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.global_line: Shared line-spacing multiplier for paragraphs, item descriptions and chat. 1.0 is normal; higher values spread lines apart and lower values bring them closer. Glyph height stays unchanged.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.wrapped: Spacing between lines of automatically wrapped paragraphs. Multiplies the overall line spacing. This does not control chat line spacing.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.tooltip: Spacing between text lines in item descriptions shown on hover. Multiplies overall line spacing. Image rows keep their original height.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.blacklist: List characters that should keep their original font. Use the list + button to add entries, then edit or remove each row. This excludes font replacement, not dot correction or text sizing.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.letter_spacing: Changes the horizontal gap between adjacent characters. 0 is normal, positive values spread letters apart and negative values bring them closer. This does not change glyph size or line spacing. Very narrow spacing may overlap letters.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.english_exclusion: Keeps horizontal spacing unchanged for English, digits and Latin characters. English-only paragraph and tooltip lines also keep their normal spacing. Mixed Japanese lines and chat line spacing still use your settings.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.existing_font: Changes the font at this GUI size. Dot coarseness 3 selects Misaki Gothic 2; every other value selects PixelMplus12. OFF keeps the standard font. English replacement has a separate switch below.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile_dots:
Chooses how coarsely to draw the standard font: 1 is fine and 4 is coarsest. Standard-font dot correction must be ON to process it.

With bundled fonts ON, 3 selects Misaki and other values select PixelMplus12. Bundled font images themselves are not processed.

To enlarge the whole text, use the Text size and spacing tab. These are GUI-size-3 reference settings, not exact screen-pixel widths at every GUI size.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.presets:
Presets set font and dot correction together for GUI sizes 1, 2, 3 and 4+. All presets keep English replacement OFF.

Only an actual profile change switches the label to Custom. Text size and spacing are separate and are not overwritten by presets. Save applies changes; Cancel discards them. Changing GUI size or these options does not open a resource reload screen.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.preset.custom: Keeps your individual GUI-size settings without replacing them with a preset. If unsure, try preset 1 first.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.preset.pixel_correcti: For keeping the standard font appearance. Corrects standard-font dots at GUI sizes 1 and 3 (coarseness 1). GUI sizes 2 and 4+ keep their original, unprocessed appearance.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.preset.pixel_and_font: For choosing a readable Japanese font to match the GUI size. Uses Misaki at GUI size 1 and PixelMplus12 at size 3. GUI sizes 2 and 4+ keep the standard font with no correction.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.preset.always_misaki: Uses compact Misaki Gothic 2 for Japanese at every GUI size: 1, 2, 3 and 4+. English and digits keep their standard font.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile.unifont_proce: Corrects the bitmap and position of standard Japanese Unifont glyphs at this GUI size. OFF keeps the native glyph image. Misaki and PixelMplus12 images are unaffected. GUI sizes 2 and 4 also use native glyphs at coarseness 1.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile.replace_engli: When a bundled font is enabled, also uses it for English, digits, symbols and Latin characters. OFF keeps their original font. This switch alone does not replace anything when bundled fonts are OFF.
